categories.main_business_segments: The company operates through four main segments: drilling services, oilfield technical services, marine vessel services, and geophysical exploration and engineering survey services. It provides single operation services, bundled services, integrated services, and turnkey contracting services across all stages of oil and gas exploration, development, and production.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes technology-driven strategies with continuous R&D investment, focusing on advanced drilling platforms (self-elevating and semi-submersible rigs), proprietary oilfield technical equipment (e.g., 'Xuanji' system), and digital transformation initiatives such as 'Xuanji Cloud'. It integrates technology products and services to deliver full lifecycle oilfield solutions, including directional drilling, logging, cementing, completion, and enhanced oil recovery technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major oil and gas companies primarily in China, with expanding international clientele in Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Americas, Europe, and Africa. The company serves upstream oil and gas exploration and production sectors, providing drilling, technical, marine support, and geophysical survey services to oilfield operators.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a strong domestic presence in China, accounting for over 77% of revenue, and actively expands internationally across Asia-Pacific, Middle East, Americas, Europe, and Africa. It operates drilling platforms and vessels in these regions and has established overseas subsidiaries and offices to support global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the oil and gas supply chain, providing essential oilfield services including drilling, technical support, marine logistics, and geophysical exploration. It acts as a service provider to upstream oil and gas producers rather than a producer or downstream distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include technology innovation, cost leadership, integration of services, internationalization, and regional development. R&D focuses on advancing drilling technologies, digital oilfield solutions, proprietary equipment development, and green low-carbon initiatives such as LNG-powered vessels and energy efficiency improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service contracts for drilling, technical services, vessel operations, and geophysical surveys. The company earns income from day rates of drilling rigs, technical service fees, vessel chartering and operation fees, and sales of proprietary oilfield products and technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest integrated oilfield service providers globally and the dominant player in the Chinese market. It competes with international oilfield service companies by leveraging its technology capabilities, integrated service offerings, and extensive domestic and international operational footprint.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 48.2 billion, a 9.5% increase year-over-year, with net profit of RMB 3.4 billion, up 3.5%. It operates over 60 drilling platforms and 200 vessels, employs over 15,000 staff, and maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by expanding international business and technology-driven efficiency gains.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, safe, efficient, and environmentally friendly full lifecycle oilfield services. Its competitive differentiation lies in its integrated service model, advanced proprietary technologies, extensive equipment fleet, and strong domestic market position combined with growing international presence.
